build_convnext_backbone: build a ConvNeXt backbone model with custom depths and dims for object detection
create_convnext_block: create a ConvNeXt Block with depthwise conv, LayerNorm, and MLP for feature extraction
extract_multi_scale_features: extract multi-scale feature maps from a ConvNeXt backbone using forward_features
init_convnext_weights: initialize ConvNeXt backbone weights from a pretrained checkpoint or random trunc_normal init
create_custom_layernorm: create a LayerNorm module that supports both channels_first and channels_last data formats
